description: Implements group-aware multi-output Ridge regression to predict IF/RNAScope nuclear fractions (Astro, EndoMural, Inhib) from bulk RNA-seq using only information available from training data. Performs grouped cross-validation by donor (from train_groups) with block-adjusted weighting to select regularization (alpha), gene scaling, and reduces overfitting to technical/training replicate structure. All hyperparameters and feature selection are learned solely from the training set. The model outputs clipped predicted fractions for the held-out test set, with shape (24,3).
